sources.title: NexaAI/table-transformer-detection-npu · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Model Description Table-Transformer-Detection is a 28.8-million-parameter object detection model from Microsoft Research, fine-tuned specifically for table detection in documents. Built on the DETR (DEtection TRansformer) architecture, it locates and identifies tables within unstructured document images such as PDFs and scanned pages.

sources.title: table-transformer-detection: Image-to-Image model — overview, use cases ...
sources.snippet: A: This model detects table locations and returns bounding boxes; the table-transformer-structure-recognition model parses cell boundaries and structure within detected tables. Use both in sequence: detection first to localize tables, then structure recognition on cropped table regions. Q: What image resolutions does this model handle?
